newsitem.title: USA: DVL Inc sees one-time $7.4 mln gain in Q3.
newsitem.headline: DVL Inc sees one-time $7.4 mln gain in Q3.

text.p: DVL Inc said Tuesday it expects a one-time before-tax gain of $7.4 million in the third quarter from the repayment of its obligations to the U.S. Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

The New Jersey-based real estate investment company said it also completed a loan transaction with NPM Capital LLC in which it refinanced three loans and received a commitment to repay parts of two other loans.

The company said it issued 1,000,000 shares to NPM Capital LLC affiliates and issued warrants to those affiliates that would allow NPM Capital to own 49 percent of outstanding DVL shares if exercised.
The one million shares represent about 6.5 percent of DVL's outstanding common stock, company Vice President Robert LoSchiavo said.
